about: Hand-checked fields from 14 real FIA stewards' decisions (2025 and 2026), copied verbatim from the published PDFs on fia.com. Reason text is cut to a short excerpt; read the full reasoning at the URL. Collected 21 Oct 2026.

decisions.fact: Car 1 collided with Car 63 at turn 5.
decisions.infringement: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
decisions.decision: 10 second time penalty. 3 penalty points (total of 11 for the 12 month period).
decisions.reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, telemetry, and in-car video evidence.

decisions.fact: Car 12 caused a collision with Car 1 in Turn 3
decisions.infringement: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
decisions.decision: Drop of 3 grid positions for the next Race in which the driver participates. 2 penalty points (total of 2 for the 12 month period).
decisions.reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 12 (Kimi Antonelli), the team representative and reviewed video evidence.

decisions.fact: Car 87 collided with Car 55 at Turn 4
decisions.infringement: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
decisions.decision: 10 second time penalty. 2 penalty points (total of 10 for the 12 month period).
decisions.reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence.

decisions.fact: Causing a collision with car 16 at turn 3
decisions.infringement: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
decisions.decision: 10 second time penalty. 2 penalty points (total of 4 for the 12 month period).
decisions.reason: It is clear that Car 12 was wholly and predominantly to blame for the collision.

decisions.infringement: Alleged breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 b) of the International Sporting Code.
decisions.reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 1 (Max Verstappen), team representatives and video and in-car video evidence.

decisions.fact: The driver of Car 55 was preparing his brakes when on the racing line between turns 11 and 12 and hindered Car 3 which was on a push lap.
decisions.infringement: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 b) of the International Sporting Code.
decisions.reason: The driver of Car 3 said he was surprised to find Car 55 travelling so slowly on the line but he did not consider the incident to be dangerous.

decisions.fact: The driver of Car 3 slowed significantly in turn 12
decisions.infringement: Alleged Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 e) of the International Sporting Code.
decisions.reason: The Driver of Car 3 then slowed significantly at turn 12 and gesticulated to the driver of Car 55 to mark his frustration

decisions.fact: Car 77 collided with Car 23 in Turn 16
decisions.infringement: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the International Sporting Code.
decisions.reason: When preparing for the re-start at the end of a Safety Car period, Car 23 collided with the rear of Car 5, and Car 77 collided with the rear of Car 23.

decisions.fact: Car 23 collided with Car 5 in Turn 16
decisions.infringement: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the International Sporting Code.
decisions.reason: When preparing for the re-start at the end of a Safety Car period, Car 23 collided with the rear of Car 5.

decisions.fact: Causing a collision with Car 63 in turn 5
decisions.infringement: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
decisions.reason: the Stewards consider that a 5-second Time Penalty, rather than the standard 10-second Time Penalty, is the appropriate penalty in accordance with the FIA Penalty Guidelines.

decisions.fact: Car 55 moved under braking and made contact with Car 14 in Turn 5.
decisions.infringement: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 e) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
decisions.reason: The Stewards determine that Car 55 moved under braking and should have left more space

decisions.fact: Car 23 caused a collision with Car 87 at Turn 6.
decisions.infringement: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
decisions.reason: therefore did not satisfy the requirements of the Driving Standards Guidelines for an inside overtake.

decisions.infringement: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
decisions.decision: 10 second time penalty converted to a drop of 5 grid positions at the next race in which the driver participates.
decisions.reason: COL braked too late and entered the corner on the inside at a speed which did not allow him to make the corner in a controlled manner.

decisions.fact: Car 5 caused a collision with Car 55 in Turn 2.
decisions.infringement: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
decisions.reason: BOR did not have his front axle alongside SAI's mirror prior to the apex.
